fact: On 17 March 2026 the governor of Haut-Uélé handed Starlink satellite internet kits at Isiro to the chiefs of the decentralised territorial entities, so that they can transmit security alerts to the provincial capital in real time in a province without telecom network; 45 chefferies and secteurs and 6 territoires received them.
title: Haut-Uélé : des kits internet satellite Starlink aux institutions pour renforcer la communication
